name: 46236 · Indianapolis, IN
findings: ZIP 46236 (Indianapolis) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46236 (Indianapolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
